content.text:
I submitted **index 7 (Sb fraction 0.543)** as the best composition. It gave the highest EQE I measured, 0.0240%. All 5 EQE measurements are used. I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements, so the phase at the peak is not confirmed.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 0.39 | 0.0047 |
| 6 | 0.50 | 0.0187 |
| **7** | **0.543** | **0.0240** |
| 8 | 0.58 | 0.0183 |
| 10 | 0.65 | 0.0140 |

- **Where the peak is:** EQE rises steeply from the copper-rich side and falls off on both sides of 0.543. That makes index 7 very likely the best of the compositions between 0.39 and 0.65. The phase database lists CuSb2O6 (Sb 0.667) and Cu3Sb4O12 (Sb 0.571) near this point. A copper-rich form of CuSb2O6 or one of those two phases is a plausible reason for the peak, but I haven't checked it.
- **What's left unchecked:**
  - Nothing above Sb 0.65 was measured (indices 11–19). EQE was already dropping toward 0.65, so I think those are unlikely to be better.
  - The narrow gaps next to index 7 weren't sampled either, since its neighbours are indices 6 and 8.
